description: Completed the three-review batch: verified the genuine scheduled workflow through terminal stages, deployed PR #71 research-age/blocker UI repairs, and verified bounded ASX Technical recovery. Full business acceptance remains partial.
databaseAndApi: No database, worker, provider or scheduler configuration changed in this batch. Production merge 81f1a39af25d351228982199d2cb25188dfc22b1 is READY as deployment dpl_7i91syFLhZrzpDfS8e2bHmS64vtN. Automatic Git deployment remains disabled.
decisions: Observed the genuine scheduled controller rather than creating a duplicate run. Controller 1.16 used source defcab4044ccbc8c34bf22198b6c9fe6ef47e015.
Opportunity completed all 10 themes. Market saved 13 independent ASX assessments with a reconciled 59-instrument ledger: 13 assessed and 46 blocked.

Verified 14 successful ASX convergence results: 13 from fresh research and one from a still-eligible earlier assessment. Two new immutable research-only recommendations were published and remain active under the shared reader logic.
External Opinion persisted a partial review with four new opinions and five source failures; its review_date is 18 November while execution occurred on 19 November UTC.

All 15 ASX target-session prices were admitted with source-matched Technical output. A previously queued targeted late-session recovery succeeded, and the scheduled Technical refresh repaired its historical hook failure without replaying provider ingestion.
UI suppresses only generic SHARED_CALL_PENDING when verified research exists; preserves other blockers and scope totals. Research cutoff warnings are presentation only.
risks: Controller evaluation remains blocked by TIINGO_SAVED_DERIVED_OUTPUT_RIGHTS_UNVERIFIED, which also excluded 44 instruments from Market. This records a runtime gate, not an independent legal determination, API failure, quota shortage or upgrade recommendation.
Two ASX issuer-document retrieval gaps remain. One has no usable AI input; the other has an eligible older assessment. No cutoff backdating or same-day duplicate research was performed.
Watchdog remained PENDING before its morning deadline; zero controller stages were running at final inspection. PENDING is not full unattended acceptance.
Authenticated production browser rendering was not exercised. Actual component rendering and deployed public assets were verified.
Historical gap recovery is bounded and demand-driven; this observation does not prove all late missing bars recover promptly.
